description.value: Church's Chicken (operating in BC as Church's Texas Chicken) is a fast-food chain specializing in fried chicken, sandwiches, tenders, and sides. This Coquitlam location offers drive-through and pickup service and is one of roughly 18 Lower Mainland locations under the same franchise. Delivery is available through DoorDash, Skip, Uber Eats, and Fantuan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the phone number (604-942-5067), full address (200-1175 Johnson Street, Coquitlam BC V3B 7K1), and explicitly lists 'WIFI' as a location feature, corroborating OSM's internet_access=wlan tag. OSM takeaway=yes and the website's 'Drive thru or pick up' language confirm takeout. No website or OSM evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, or water refill; the OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website clearly places this location in Coquitlam.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website clearly places this location in Coquitlam, BC — address community mismatch.
OSM name is 'Church's Chicken' but the business operates in BC under the brand 'Church's Texas Chicken'; the two names co-exist but may cause confusion.
Unit number (200) present in OSM addr:unit tag but omitted from the OSM address string; website shows full address as 200-1175 Johnson Street.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Generic national fast-food chain with no confirmed bike parking (the sole required criterion for this category), no cyclist-specific amenities beyond Wi-Fi and takeout, and no qualities that would make it a notable or differentiated stop for touring cyclists over any other fast-food outlet.
